'''Vic Mignogna''' is a voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} and the [[I Choose You! trilogy|''I Choose You!'' trilogy]].

==Biography==
Mignogna was born on August 27, 1962 in Greensburg, Pennsylvania. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|BW}}, voicing several minor roles before gaining his most notable role of {{OBP|Keldeo|M15}} during ''[[M15|Kyurem VS. The Sword of Justice]]''. Mignogna then voiced [[Saizo]], [[Sanpei]]'s mentor, during {{aniseries|XY}}.
